note: Per user decision: with-skill runs only, no baseline runs. Fixtures under evals/fixtures/ are copied into each run's project dir before the run.

evals.name: messy-bundle-full-lint
evals.prompt: Our knowledge bundle at knowledge/ has been through a bunch of edits by different people and I suspect it's drifted — docs contradicting each other, indexes out of date, that kind of thing. Can you lint it and write up what you find?
evals.expected_output: Severity-ranked LINT_REPORT next to knowledge/ catching seeded contradictions, drift, taxonomy splits, and hygiene items; bundle untouched.
assertions: A lint report file (LINT_REPORT_*.md) exists next to the knowledge/ bundle root, not inside it
The knowledge/ bundle itself was not modified (identical to the fixture)
Catches the join-key contradiction: orders.md says join on customer_id, customers.md says join on email
Catches the column-type contradiction: orders.md declares total_usd NUMERIC, customers.md calls it FLOAT64
Catches the cancelled-orders contradiction: orders.md excludes cancelled orders, gmv.md sums the orders table 'including cancelled orders'
Catches the SLA contradiction: freshness.md says the orders freshness SLA is 30 minutes, backfill.md says it is 90 minutes
Catches the duplicate concept: order_facts.md and orders.md describe the same table (same resource URI, same description)
Catches index drift: tables/index.md does not list refunds.md and/or its orders description drifted from frontmatter
Catches log problems: dates not newest-first and/or the dead link to /tables/returns.md
Catches taxonomy case-duplicates: playbook/Playbook type split and/or sales/Sales tag split
Catches at least 2 of the 3 hygiene seeds: TODO in refunds.md schema, empty '# Examples' in refunds.md, template leftover '<describe sampling methodology here>' in nps.md
Contradiction findings quote evidence from both sides with file references

evals.name: clean-bundle-false-positives
evals.prompt: Before we tag a release of the payments docs, run a consistency lint over knowledge/ and give me a report.
evals.expected_output: Short, confident report; no High findings, no invented contradictions; checked-and-clean section present.
assertions: A lint report file (LINT_REPORT_*.md) exists next to the knowledge/ bundle root, not inside it
The knowledge/ bundle itself was not modified (identical to the fixture)
The report contains zero High-severity findings
The report does not invent a contradiction (e.g., does not claim the 100 req/min rate limits in charge.md and refund.md conflict — they agree)
The report includes a checked-and-clean section stating which check categories passed
The report is short and confident, not padded with manufactured Low findings (3 or fewer total findings)

evals.name: subtle-contradictions
evals.prompt: Something feels off in our identity platform docs — I was reading the auth pages and came away confused. Can you check knowledge/ for inconsistencies and tell me what you find?
evals.expected_output: Report catching the three purely-semantic contradictions (token lifetime 24h vs 12h, revocation semantics, refresh reuse) with quoted two-sided evidence, all rated High.
assertions: A lint report file (LINT_REPORT_*.md) exists next to the knowledge/ bundle root, not inside it
The knowledge/ bundle itself was not modified (identical to the fixture)
Catches the token-lifetime contradiction: 24 hours in tokens.md vs 12 hours in sessions.md
Catches the revocation-semantics contradiction: tokens.md says outstanding access tokens remain valid (stateless) vs sessions.md says they stop working within seconds (revocation list)
Catches the refresh-reuse contradiction: tokens.md says refresh tokens are single-use and rotate vs rate-limits.md says reusable for up to five refreshes
Contradiction findings quote evidence from both sides with file references
All three contradictions are rated High severity
